description: Search the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List (individuals and entities) by name or alias. Returns matching listed records with their aliases, listing regime (`un_list_type`), and identifying details, plus a `stale` flag when the underlying snapshot is older than the freshness window and a `snapshot.retrieved` flag that is false if no snapshot has ever been obtained yet.

query.description: Name, alias or exact ID number.

un_list_type.description: Restrict to a UN sanctions regime, e.g. 'DRC'.

name: un_sanctions__search
title: Search UN Sanctions List
